question: Does the Manila North Water Reclamation Facility EPRMP's Estero de Vitas freshwater-ecology chapter provide fish-occurrence evidence?

method.summary: Reviewed the EMB-DMS-hosted EPRMP cover and the Estero de Vitas freshwater-ecology sampling stations, methods, and results, then checked the adjacent marine-ecology heading to keep habitat lanes separate. Searched the report for Oreochromis, freshwater fish, fish sampling, fish species, and ichthyofauna as bounded term checks.
accessNotes: The PDF identifies PHILKAIROS Incorporated as preparer and Maynilad Water Services, Inc. as project proponent for the proposed Manila North Water Reclamation Project at Barangay 105, Vitas, Tondo, Manila.

The report's dedicated freshwater-ecology section identifies Estero de Vitas sampling stations FE-1 through FE-3. It specifies a plankton net and a macroinvertebrate kick-net method and discusses plankton results plus no macroinvertebrates found during the sampling period.
The report mentions December 19, 2024 water sampling in a separate surface-water-quality section; no explicit link was found assigning that date to freshwater biological collection.
No local PDF, map, coordinate, station image, table, or ecological data file was retained.
method.reuseFinding: No item-specific reuse license or permission to republish EPRMP text, maps, images, tables, or underlying observations was verified. This review records an attributed scope summary only.

sourceFindings.scope: The EPRMP lists three Estero de Vitas freshwater-ecology stations. Its methods describe plankton-net collection and macroinvertebrate kick-net sampling; the results section presents plankton taxa and says no macroinvertebrate species were found during the sampling period.
sourceFindings.limits: The reviewed freshwater chapter does not describe a fish-capture method, name fish taxa, provide fish counts, or give fish voucher/specimen records. Generic use of the words freshwater ecology or freshwater species does not establish that fish were collected. The chapter's biological sampling date was not tied to the separate surface-water-quality date in the reviewed text.
sourceFindings.attribution: Use this EPRMP for attributed waterbody and freshwater-station context only. Do not add fish species or occurrence records from this chapter.

scopeDecision.decision: Waterbody and non-fish ecology context only; fish-occurrence-ineligible.

nonClaims: The absence of fish methods and taxa in this reviewed chapter is not evidence that fish are absent from Estero de Vitas.
Station coordinates are not reproduced here and do not define Estero de Vitas geometry or establish fish capture localities.
The 19 December 2024 surface-water sampling date is not treated as the freshwater-biota sampling date.
The reported Station 3 relationship to the mouth joining Estero de Vitas and Estero de Sunog Apog is not a fish-occurrence crosswalk or validated waterbody boundary.
No current water-quality, fishing-access, legal-harvest, catchability, safety, or species-presence claim is made.
nextActions: Continue seeking a dated, field-based Estero de Vitas fish survey with species-level identifications, station linkage, and specimen or voucher provenance.
Keep the EPRMP in waterbody-scope context and record fish-evidence gaps without converting them into absence claims.
